messages:
Ava (FinOps): morning — noticed a weird spike in eu-west-1 on the per-route cost view last night, looks like on-demand jumped ~3x for a 2hr window :eyes:
Marco (eng-infra): ugh. link to the dashboard?
Ava (FinOps): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/finops/per-route-cost?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west-1 — zoom to 02:00-04:00 UTC, model=redwood-gen2-medium, route=/chat/generate
Priya (eng-sre): I can pull logs. costbot: Billing export shows an increase in compute_on_demand for eu-west-1 between 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-17T04:00:00Z.
Lila (finance): raw billing link: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/transactions?project=redwood-prod — cost delta ~ $18k for that window, verified on the billing export.
Marco (eng-infra): quick hypothesis: autoscaler fallback to on-demand because the reserved pool reported nodes as NotReady during a transient network partition. We saw a BGP flapping event at ~01:58 UTC in the infra logs.
Priya (eng-sre): confirming k8s events show lots of `NodeNotReady` for eu-west-1-gpu-pool-3 at 01:59-02:15. paste of events:
```
Mar 17 01:59:12 kubelet[...]: NodeNotReady: NetworkUnavailable
Mar 17 02:03:01 controller: cordon/evict -> scale-up on-demand
```
Marco (eng-infra): exactly. autoscaler policy currently prefers on-demand when node readiness is low. We can switch to prefer-dedicated for critical routes but that requires reserved capacity headroom.
Jonah (product): what percentage of traffic is that route responsible for? this was a PLG overnight job spike?
Ava (FinOps): last-hit attribution: route /chat/generate = 42% of tokens in that window, model=gen2-medium accounted for 70% of compute. Looks like a batch inference job from an external partner kicked off at 02:00.
Lila (finance): partner billing was not flagged — partner tag missing on some requests. that's why cost allocation showed it as "unattributed" and inflated product line numbers.
Priya (eng-sre): we should patch the autoscaler fallback immediately so we don't default to on-demand during partial network outages. quick fix: change fallback to prefer dedicated pool and use a soft throttle instead of scale-to-zero for reserved pools.
Marco (eng-infra): agreed. I'll open an infra change and run it in eu-west-1 canary. Proposed change (kube-autoscaler config snippet):
```
fallbackPolicy:
  - preferPool: reserved-gpu
  - maxOnDemandRatio: 0.15
  - scaleTimeout: 600s
```
Ava (FinOps): also recommend we add an alert to the FinOps dashboard: if on-demand % of region > 20% for 15m => pager to eng-infra + finops. :rotating_light:
Jonah (product): and we need a tagging playbook for external partners — if requests lack `x-partner-id` header or `partner` tag, drop into `unattributed` but also send a debug alert to infra so we can contact partner.
Lila (finance): I'll update the allocation rules to retroactively attribute charges where we can using IP + request traces, and mark the remaining as partner_unattributed for next billing cycle.
Priya (eng-sre): quick query I ran against logs (BigQuery):
```
SELECT request_route, SUM(tokens) tokens, SUM(cost) cost
FROM `billing.events`
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-17 01:50:00' AND '2026-03-17 04:10:00'
GROUP BY request_route
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Priya (eng-sre): output shows `/chat/generate` top, then `/embed/batch` minor.
Marco (eng-infra): action items:
- change autoscaler fallback config (I) — canary deploy eu-west-1 in 30m
- add FinOps alert rule (Ava + Priya)
- tagging playbook for partners + request header enforcement (Jonah + Lila)
- retro attribution script (Lila)
Ava (FinOps): can we also get the per-model latency breakdown? if dedicated nodes were NotReady maybe requests were queued and retried causing both cost and latency blips.
Priya (eng-sre): yes, linking latency panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/per-model?var-region=eu-west-1&from=now-6h&to=now - shows 500ms spike aligned to the same window. retries visible in request logs.
Jonah (product): assign owner for partner communication? I'll take point with partner success and loop in their SRE.
Lila (finance): I'll reconcile billing and prepare a one-pager for the execs with cost impact and mitigations.
Ava (FinOps): thanks all. let's aim for the autoscaler change + alert in the next 48h. please post rollouts and any anomalies back here. :thumbsup:
